applies_to: Trane dual-compressor (duplex) CenTraVac water-cooled centrifugal chillers fitted with the Symbio 800 controller, as listed in the Duplex tables of BAS-PTS009C-EN (12/12/2025).
summary: Trane's duplex CenTraVac pairs two centrifugal compressors on separate refrigerant circuits in one water-cooled chiller. With the Symbio 800 controller it serves BACnet and Modbus RTU/TCP from one points list. This map covers analog inputs for both circuits (water temperatures and flows, refrigerant and oil pressures, purge, starter/drive and energy values), BAS setpoints, binary status points, circuit lockouts, multi-state modes and the diagnostic flags.

addressing.note: The list prints Modicon register numbers: 3xxxx are input registers and 4xxxx holding registers, so 30011 is input register address 10 and 42011 is holding register address 2010.

source.title: Symbio 800 Integration Points List, BACnet/Modbus, CenTraVac

notes: Register format table: analog points are 32-bit floats sent high word / high byte first (NaN = invalid); binary and multi-state points are unsigned 16-bit integers (0xFFFF = invalid).
Values are sent in the unit system ordered from the factory (I-P is the usual default, SI optional); the list names only the quantity, so temperature/pressure/flow units are left blank here.
Not every point exists on every unit: the controller builds its point set from the unit's configuration. Descriptions name the configuration a point depends on.
Register numbers are printed in 5-digit Modicon form (3xxxx input registers, 4xxxx holding registers) and converted here to wire addresses (30011 = input register 10).

Controller setup, serial defaults and the I-P/SI units statement come from the list's named reference document, Trane's Symbio 800 BACnet and Modbus integration guide BAS-SVP083B-EN (15 Nov 2024, https://elibrary.tranetechnologies.com/public/commercial-hvac/Literature/Integration/BAS-SVP083B-EN_11152024.pdf).
The document carries separate Simplex and Duplex tables that reuse the same register numbers for different points; do not mix them.
The 'Diagnostic Codes' pages (code number to text for the Last Diagnostic Code points) are not reproduced.
This is the Symbio 800 register set. Duplex CenTraVacs with the older UC800/Tracer AdaptiView controller use a different native map (see centravac-duplex-uc800).

integration.summary: Read the analog inputs as pairs of input registers (float, high word first) and the binary/multi-state points as single registers. Write the BAS setpoints and command points in the 4xxxx holding range.
integration.enable: On the Symbio 800 web interface go to Installation > Identification and Communications > Protocol Configuration and select Modbus RTU or Modbus TCP (per Trane's Symbio 800 integration guides).
quirks: Analog values are 32-bit floats in two consecutive registers, high word first.
0xFFFF in a binary or multi-state register and NaN in an analog register mean the value is invalid or not present.
setup: The Modbus RTU address comes from the controller's rotary dials (1-247); address 000 disables Modbus RTU.
Serial defaults are 19200 bps, even parity, 1 stop bit (set in the web interface's Protocol Configuration tab); wire RS-485 to the P1 link.

Modbus TCP uses Ethernet port 1 (port 2 is reserved for the touch screen) and the IP address set on the IP Configuration tab; the rotary address is ignored for TCP and the Wi-Fi module is not supported for Modbus TCP.
gotchas: Points not supported by the unit's configuration are absent; confirm the configuration dependencies before mapping.
